title.purpose: Section headings and hover card titles.

body.purpose: Row values; a row's name is weight 500.

label.purpose: Buttons, column headers, footers and key hints.

micro.purpose: Initials inside a person mark and the smallest button's label; never running text.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Hover cards, menus and peek panels, on the popover layer (z-index 50); nothing in the page flow casts a shadow.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Opening a floating layer such as the field card.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for a layer that opens.

motion.name: field-card-enter-scale
motion.purpose: The field card's starting scale; closing is instant and reduced motion disables it.

breakpoints.name: abbreviate
breakpoints.purpose: Container width below which a record row column shows its short form.

breakpoints.name: hide
breakpoints.purpose: Container width below which a record row column marked to hide disappears.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent-filled control; marks the action the caller can take.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1.625 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action with no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1.625 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Record Row
components.description: One record: rank 1 identify, then rank 2 readings; square, 44px, separated by a hairline.
components.html: INV-1042Harbour Freight Ltd$12,480.00
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, transparent); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: none; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent); } .ds-row-key { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-row-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-name { text-decoration: underline 2px var(--ring); } .ds-row-read { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Field Card
components.description: Rank 4 hover card on one entity's trigger; its radius is its content's radius plus its padding.
components.html:
Dana Whitfield

Accounts payable, Sydney
components.css: .ds-field-card { width: 240px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6 + 12px); background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); font: 400 0.75rem/1.33 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); } .ds-field-card p { margin: 4px 0 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field-card-action { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.6); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: A state as a shape and a word, readable in greyscale.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Person Mark
components.description: Initials in a quiet circle, then the name.
components.css: .ds-person { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 "Mona Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-person-initials { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: The system is defined by the relationships between components, not by the components alone: how data is ranked, which parts fit into which slots, which components render on which surface, which sit next to each other, how much space separates one type from another, and how a radius builds outward from its content. Each component encodes the relationships it takes part in, so callers assemble new surfaces freely and every assembly stays consistent. The palette is monochrome with one orange that marks only what can be acted on; density is high and depth is flat.
keyCharacteristics: Components declare which components they contain, sit beside and sit inside.
One accent, used only on actionable elements and the focus ring.
44px rows with 24×24px hit areas that grow to 44×44px on a coarse pointer.
State shown by shape and word, never by colour alone.
A radius builds outward from a 6px floor; --radius: 0 makes every radius 0.
The container sets the gap between its children: run 0, related 8px, section 24px.

rules.name: The Act-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears only on something the caller can act on, or on the focus ring.

rules.name: The No-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: A state is carried by a shape and a word, so it reads in greyscale.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number compared down a column uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow at rest; a shadow means the layer floats and will close.

rules.name: The Outward Radius Rule
rules.body: A container's radius is its content's radius plus its padding, so a container never picks a radius on its own.

dos: Do take every colour, radius, spacing, type, shadow, motion, layer and breakpoint value from a token; tokens are authored in packages/tokens/src and generated into packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.gen.css and theme.gen.css.
Do derive a container's radius from its content's radius plus its padding.
Do let the container set the gap between its children from --spacing-run, --spacing-related or --spacing-section.
Do keep row actions hidden until hover, focus or selection, and always visible on a coarse pointer.
Do give every hit area at least 24×24px, and 44×44px on a coarse pointer.
Do use tabular figures for any number compared down a column.
donts: Don't use Signal Orange on anything the caller cannot act on.
Don't show a state by colour alone; pair it with a shape and a word.
Don't put a shadow on a surface that sits in the page flow.
Don't add a second typeface; use Mona Sans weights and widths.
Don't give a component margin or a hard-coded radius; both come from its container.
Don't write an untokenised value such as text-[0.625rem], z-50 or duration-150 in a published component; add a token instead.
